# Optional creation interview

Read only when guided design was selected. Reuse the original request and accepted clarifications;
never ask the user to repeat information already supplied.

Ask one concise grouped set of questions only for material missing details across **Skills**,
**Tools and workflows**, **Instructions**, **Data and knowledge**, and **Settings**. Ask for concrete
SharePoint locations, URLs, or files when grounding is requested.

For **Settings**, consider persistent user memory only when material to the scenario and not already
specified by the user. Explain that it retains user-specific context across conversations, using
the behavior and limitations in [the shared memory contract](components.md#persistent-user-memory)
before asking. Do not enable memory by default or make a memory decision a required creation step;
without an explicit enable/disable request, preserve the existing setting or its absence.

Do not require every category, ask duplicate questions, or block an instructions-only agent because
richer components were not specified. Topics are not part of the MCS2 agent model.
